fact_rationales.F7: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis can be seen in various vascular tumors and metastatic disease, but the presence of atypical cells and GATA3 positivity points towards metastatic breast carcinoma.
fact_rationales.F9: Nests of highly atypical cells in a vessel are more typical of metastatic carcinoma than primary vascular tumors.

ranked_facts.why: highly atypical cells in a vessel are more typical of metastatic carcinoma
